# Simple rule: fill gaps between consecutive 2s if gap >= 4
def row_transform(row):
    result = row.copy()
    cols_2 = [i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    
    for i in range(len(cols_2) - 1):
        start = cols_2[i]
        end = cols_2[i+1]
        gap = end - start - 1  # number of empty cells
        
        if gap >= 4:

    return result
